title: Monday's boring SaaS, 12 October 2026
dek: Monday, 12 October 2026. Nine are Stripe-verified. Heron Copier is Creem-verified, and Dropkiller's Stripe key went stale in August.

companies.name: DOWNCONVERT SKETCHUP FILES
companies.description: Open newer SketchUp files (2026 → 2017) in older versions. Founded Dec 2025, UAE. ~22k signed-in users, ~12k monthly visitors (founder-stated). Listed for sale at $17,900. Pricing: €3.90 per conversion or €24.90 unlimited one-time.
companies.evidence: ~$3,339 MRR (+8.6% L30 MRR growth), 40 active subscriptions, ~$5,306 L30, ~$35,996 all-time, ~95% L30 profit margin. Asking price $17,900. Revenue synced Oct 11, 2026 ~10:22 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Same Conductor-lane lesson — wrap one painful versioning protocol, own the Google result, sell or keep the cash cow.
companies.whyItPrints: Architects and contractors still sit on old SketchUp seats; clients send 2026 files. A one-trick converter ranks for the query and charges only when someone needs more than the free trial — classic format-glue SEO.

companies.name: Mon Atelier
companies.description: All-in-one ERP for phone / PC / appliance / bike repair shops: tickets, quotes, invoices, stock, POS, online booking, customer SMS. French compliance baked in (NF525, 2026 e-invoicing via Pennylane, second-hand police ledger, FEC, QualiRépar). Founded Mar 2026, France. 48 shops (founder-stated). Listed for sale at $120,000. Solo €19 / Pro €39 per month.
companies.evidence: ~$2,641 MRR (+16.7% L30), 65 active subscriptions, ~$3,464 L30, ~$17,563 all-time. Asking price $120,000 (~2.9×). Revenue synced Oct 12, 2026 ~07:54 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Verticalize one trade + one country's tax/compliance stack — then sell to the next country with the same playbook.
companies.whyItPrints: Repair shops live on post-its; generic invoicing ignores repair workflows and FR regulation. Compliance is the moat; a 20-store franchise is said to be onboarding.

companies.name: Image-Charts
companies.description: SaaS API that renders charts (static or animated) as images for emails, PDFs, reports, and chatbots — Zapier/Make friendly. Founded 2017, France. Business $89/mo yearly / Enterprise $224/mo yearly (company-stated).
companies.evidence: ~$6,281 MRR, 50 active subscriptions, ~$2,343 L30, ~$541,380 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 12, 2026 ~04:25 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Sell a single developer utility as an image CDN for charts — high all-time, low feature churn, Zapier distribution.
companies.whyItPrints: Embedding interactive charts in email clients is a nightmare; a URL that returns a PNG/GIF is the boring fix. Nine-year-old API with half a million all-time is quiet glue revenue.

companies.name: Send Letters Online UK
companies.description: Type a letter in the browser; they print, fold, frank, and post via Royal Mail from £2.99. Volume discounts from 100 letters/month. Founded May 2026, UK. GDPR / ICO registered (company-stated). Pay-per-letter, not seat SaaS.
companies.evidence: Seat MRR shown as $0 (transactional / pay-per-letter). ~$4,283 L30, ~$21,160 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 12, 2026 ~06:53 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Digitise a regulated physical workflow in one country; volume discounts and public-sector RFPs do the sales.
companies.whyItPrints: Courts, landlords, SMEs, and public sector still need physical post. Hybrid mail is dull infrastructure with tangible COGS and sticky repeat volume.
companies.imageAlt: Send Letters Online UK product image

companies.name: Plate Lookup
companies.description: Lookup any vehicle by plate or VIN: specs, auction/sales history, recalls, photos, market value, accidents, odometer, title brands. Founded 2019, US. ~3.8k estimated users (TrustMRR). Mostly one-time / report checkout (low seat MRR).
companies.evidence: ~$32 MRR / 4 active subscriptions (reports dominate over seats). ~$7,643 L30, ~$53,416 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 12, 2026 ~05:28 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Wrap government + auction data behind a simple plate search page; upsell API later.
companies.whyItPrints: Car buyers and dealers pay to avoid lemons; plate/VIN APIs are a classic data-wrapper business with SEO front-door and API back-door.

companies.name: Dropkiller
companies.description: Subscription platform for e-comm entrepreneurs (esp. LatAm): product insights, ad creatives, market analysis. Founded Oct 2024, US. ~10k estimated users. Note: Stripe API key on TrustMRR expired Aug 2026 — figures below are the last verified sync, not live Oct data.
companies.evidence: ~$60,179 MRR (snapshot at last sync), 2,702 active subscriptions, ~$49,511 L30 (as of sync window), ~$452,343 all-time. Last synced ~22:22 Warsaw 15 Aug 2026 (stale Stripe key on TrustMRR).
companies.indieAngle: Niche market-intel SaaS for one region's e-comm operators — language + payment rails as moat.
companies.whyItPrints: Dropshippers and DTC brands pay monthly for winning-product dashboards. High seat count, checkout + recurring mix.

companies.name: Podawaa
companies.description: LinkedIn-focused publishing, engagement, and analytics platform. Founded Jun 2024, France (Tom Benattar). Plans: Community free / Scale €59 / Accelerate €89 / Dominate €159 per month. ~10k estimated users. 90% L30 profit margin snapshot.
companies.evidence: ~$66,590 MRR, 619 active subscriptions, ~$57,822 L30, ~$1,204,292 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 12, 2026 ~08:35 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Own one social network deeply (not all platforms) — higher willingness to pay per seat.
companies.whyItPrints: LinkedIn is the B2B distribution channel that still works; a focused scheduler/engagement tool compounds with agency seats.

companies.name: POST BRIDGE
companies.description: One dashboard to publish the same content to multiple social platforms. Founded Sep 2024, Canada (jack friks). Marketer $39/mo / Operator $99/mo. ~1.9k estimated users. 92% L30 profit margin snapshot; DataFast traffic connected.
companies.evidence: ~$49,117 MRR, 1,689 active subscriptions, ~$51,063 L30 (snapshot ~$51,218), ~$531,501 all-time, ~40,757 L30 visitors / ~$1.26 revenue per visitor. Revenue synced Oct 11, 2026 ~22:02 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Buffer/Later alternative at founder-friendly pricing — distribution via the founder's own audience.
companies.whyItPrints: Creators hate logging into five apps. Simple cross-posting at indie price points scales with seat count and organic X distribution.

companies.name: DataExpert / TechCreator
companies.description: Structured data-engineering / AI upskilling programs with hands-on cloud access (Databricks, AWS, Snowflake). Founded Mar 2023, US (Zach Wilson). $119/mo (company-stated).
companies.evidence: ~$56,127 MRR, 877 active subscriptions, ~$44,360 L30, ~$4,729,562 all-time. Revenue synced Oct 12, 2026 ~04:02 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Expert-led vertical education with cloud lab access — high LTV, content moat, not an AI toy.
companies.whyItPrints: Working engineers pay for career acceleration; cohort + subscription education prints for years. Nearly $4.7M Stripe all-time is the proof.

companies.name: Heron Copier
companies.description: Cloud + local trade copier and journal across MetaTrader, cTrader, DXtrade, and more — unlimited master/slave, live dashboards. Founded Jun 2023, Indonesia. Free 7-day trial / $19/mo / $179/yr. Creem + Polar verified on TrustMRR.
companies.evidence: ~$7,594 MRR, 456 active subscriptions, ~$7,186 L30, ~$498,420 all-time, ~80% L30 profit margin. Also Polar-connected on TrustMRR. Revenue synced Oct 12, 2026 ~00:09 Warsaw.
companies.indieAngle: Niche fintech utility for one workflow (copy trading) across many brokers — support is the product.
companies.whyItPrints: Prop traders and signal sellers need reliable copy infra; platform sprawl makes a multi-broker copier sticky. Half a million all-time on a $19 seat.
